title: senna timoriensis
intro: Senna timoriensis, commonly known as the East Timorese senna, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to the island of Timor. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including digestive issues and fever, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting detoxification. The therapeutic actions of Senna timoriensis include its laxative properties, which help to relieve constipation, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory actions, which aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of Senna timoriensis include sennosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
